_about: The Meshy prompts for every model in VELSCOUR TACTICS, second version (ornate). A full prompt is a subject line plus a style block. `node tools/meshy/prompt.mjs <key>` prints one ready to paste; `node tools/meshy/prompt.mjs` lists the keys. docs/MODELS.md explains the look and what each model is for. Seventeen models were made from prompts this file no longer gives word for word (pictures redrawn from another picture, the old tree style, lines edited after sending, picture fixes): tools/meshy/sent.json has exactly what was sent for those, with every Meshy task id, and `node tools/meshy/prompt.mjs <key> sent` prints it.
look: Ornate high-fantasy job armour in the manner of Final Fantasy XIV's artifact and raid sets, made grimdark for VELSCOUR, and matching the models in the bm repo (its knights, its hired heroes, Lisandra's two forms).
Proportions are tall and realistic, about seven and a half heads, elegant, never chibi or cute.

Every figure is a designed costume, not generic fantasy kit: layered plate, brocade, tooled leather, engraved filigree borders, jewelled clasps, long split tabards and trailing sashes, one asymmetric piece (a single great pauldron, a half-cape, a mantle), and a headpiece that gives the silhouette away at a glance.

Each class has a costume source and a twist: a sun-cathedral's processional guard, a frozen fighting-pit's champion, a courteous undertaker. Fancy first, then worn: dented, candle-sooted, frost-rimed, mended with gold thread.

VELSCOUR's Grim Nocturne palette: blackened grave steel, tarnished reliquary gold, deep wine, night indigo, bone ivory, undead flesh. One bold hue pair per figure. Rarity shows in craft, never in brightness or glow.

Never: plain peasant clothes, flat undecorated armour, skull pauldrons, spikes on everything, glowing eyes, faceless hoods, bat wings, neon. By the V and T rule, no letters, runes, monograms or heraldic emblems anywhere: decoration is abstract filigree, scrollwork, leaves, feathers, scales.

style.character: Original character design for a dark gothic high-fantasy MMORPG, in the ornate job-armor tradition of Final Fantasy XIV artifact gear: tall elegant realistic proportions, about 7.5 heads, intricate layered costume with engraved filigree borders, rich brocade, tooled leather and jeweled fittings, asymmetric silhouette, long trailing cloth. Grimdark palette of blackened grave steel, tarnished gold, deep wine, night indigo and bone ivory; worn, battle-scarred, candle-sooted; sombre and regal, never cute, never generic. Semi-realistic painted 3D game character, very high detail. Abstract scrollwork decoration only: no text, letters, runes, heraldic emblems or logos anywhere.
style.fitted: Original character design for a dark gothic high-fantasy MMORPG, in the ornate job-armor tradition of Final Fantasy XIV artifact gear: tall elegant realistic proportions, about 7.5 heads, intricate layered costume with engraved filigree borders, rich brocade, tooled leather and jeweled fittings, a bold silhouette made by the shoulders and the headpiece. Close-fitting: no cape, no cloak, no mantle, no robe, no long coat, no tabard, no hanging sash ends or streamers; every garment ends above the knee and the legs are clear from the knee to the boots. Grimdark palette of blackened grave steel, tarnished gold, deep wine, night indigo and bone ivory; worn, battle-scarred, candle-sooted; sombre and regal, never cute, never generic. Semi-realistic painted 3D game character, very high detail. Abstract scrollwork decoration only: no text, letters, runes, heraldic emblems, crosses or logos anywhere.
style.monster: Original monster design for a dark gothic high-fantasy MMORPG: realistic proportions, grotesque and specific, intricate ragged detail, burial finery gone to rot. Grimdark palette of undead flesh, grave steel, deep wine and night indigo; sombre, never cute, never generic. Semi-realistic painted 3D game creature, very high detail. No text, letters, runes or emblems anywhere.
style.creature: Original creature design for a dark gothic high-fantasy MMORPG: realistic proportions, specific and a little ornate, grimdark palette, semi-realistic painted 3D game creature, very high detail. No text, letters, runes or emblems anywhere. Whole body, neutral standing pose, single creature, plain background.
style.weapon: A single {subject}, an ornate high-fantasy MMORPG weapon in the tradition of Final Fantasy XIV relic arms: elaborate engraved filigree, jeweled fittings, a bold unusual silhouette, blackened grave steel and dark wood with tarnished gold, worn and grimdark, matte, no glow, no text or runes. negative: generic fantasy, plain armor, simple clothes, peasant, chibi, cartoon, big head, cute, stylized low-poly, weapon in hand, text, letters, runes, logo, heraldic emblem, skull shoulder pads, glowing eyes, base, pedestal, multiple characters

settings.pose: a-pose for the picture and the 3D step; bodies always have empty hands, weapons are separate models (the a-pose 3D step drops anything held in the picture anyway)
settings.triangles: about 30k for heroes and classes, 15-20k for monsters and townsfolk
settings.textures: 2k from Meshy; the game copy is cut to 1024
settings.route: text to image first (so the design can be seen and checked for letters and emblems), then image to 3D, then rig
settings.in_game: these figures are realistically proportioned: no head or leg bone scaling in the manifest, height about 1.8 tiles

gender: Each class needs a male and a female body. The subject lines below describe one of the two; the tool swaps 'man' and 'woman' and asks for the other cut of the same costume in the same colours.

named.lisandra: An ancient witch three hundred years old, gaunt and regal, an old woman with sharp cheekbones and a long silver braid, slightly stooped; a towering crooked black felt hat banded with tarnished silver chain and dried herbs; a floor-length gown of layered black and ember-brown brocade mended with hundreds of tiny gold-thread stitches, a high boned collar, long trailing sleeves, a tooled leather corset hung with keys, candle stubs and glass phials, an ornate wrought-iron lantern on a chain at her hip, a mantle of crow feathers over one shoulder

named.jamie: A lean monk-jeweler and curator, a wiry man; a long teal surcoat with gold-thread hems over fine dark mail, a wide leather harness of small drawers, pouches and ring-trays, brass jeweler's loupes on an articulated headband pushed up on his forehead, a hand drill on a cord, fingerless gloves, a short shoulder cape pinned with a great cut-gem brooch, two crescent blade holsters crossed on his back
named.stevie: A broad powerful woman armorer with wild red curls; heavy ornate tournament plate with fluted pauldrons and a tall gorget, sleeves rolled to show her forearms, a thick armorer's apron of riveted leather over the cuirass, layered articulated tassets, oversized engraved gauntlets, a dented open-faced helm hanging at her belt, a tower-shield bracket on the left arm

classes.totem_master: A speaker for the old spirits, a broad man; a tall carved wooden spirit mask crowned with feathers pushed up on the head, a heavy ceremonial mantle of teal and ochre woven bands, an ornate bone and jade breastplate of stacked carved plaques, armlets of beaten copper, hanging talismans of feather, tooth and knotted cord, wrapped legs and bare feet
classes.death_knight: A fallen champion bound in frost, a towering man; blackened ornate full plate rimed with ice, a crowned closed helm with a narrow slit, a tattered wine cloak frozen stiff, pale blue frost tracing every engraved border, a plain unmarked breastplate with no emblem and no chest symbol, layered spaulders like stacked icicles, chains of office broken across the chest
classes.arcane_sorcerer: A royal astronomer, a tall woman; a night-indigo robe of heavy brocade sewn with pale silver star studs, a towering brass armillary headdress of nested rings, a half-veil over the lower face, a tall flared collar, an ornate astrolabe on a long chain, a mantle like a folded star chart of indigo and gold, long gloves, brass lenses on a jeweled band
classes.carrion_witch: A swamp hag of grim elegance, an old woman; a huge crooked wide-brimmed black hat hung with small bones and dried flowers, a ragged layered gown of moss green and black lace, a great mantle of crow feathers with a high feathered collar, an ornate corset of tarnished silver ribs, a rag poppet doll and glass jars tied at the belt, a muddy hem, long nails
classes.bard: A roguish court minstrel, a handsome man; a wine-red and black doublet of quilted brocade with one sleeve slashed to gold silk, a wide feathered hat cocked to one side, a long asymmetric half-cape lined in indigo, ornate knife sheaths on a baldric of silver links, thigh boots with turned cuffs, fingerless gloves, ribbons and small bells at the cuffs
classes.slime_lord: A king made of translucent cobalt slime in the shape of a stout powerful man; an ornate tarnished gold crown of plain spikes and gems sinking into his head; heavy ornate armour of tarnished gold and blackened grave steel strapped over the ooze: a sculpted gold cuirass, great rounded gold pauldrons, gold-banded vambraces and gauntlets on glossy slime hands, a belt of overlapping gold plates, short armoured tassets, gold greaves and sabatons, the slime bulging and dripping between every plate; gold chains of office, jewelled rings and old coins floating inside the slime body; no cape, no mantle, no robe, no cloth at all
classes.boomerang_knight: A dashing knight of the returning moon, a lean man; a teal and silver surcoat over fine engraved mail, a rounded crested helm with a tall white plume, a single crescent-shaped pauldron, two great curved blade holsters crossed on the back, a short cape pinned at one shoulder, tall riding boots with silver spurs, long gauntlets
classes.lancer: An unbreakable knight-captain, a massive broad man; towering ornate full plate enamelled deep midnight blue and edged in heavy tarnished gold filigree, the heaviest armour of any class, every plate thick, fluted and sculpted with gold scrollwork and leaves: huge tiered rounded pauldrons as big as the helm, a deep sculpted breastplate with a tall flared gorget, a close helm with a tall swept gold fin crest and a plain faceplate with one narrow horizontal eye slit and no vertical ridge, articulated arms with flared winged couters and enormous gauntlets, a broad fauld of overlapping gold-edged lames, short broad tassets ending above the knee, sculpted poleyns, greaves and thick armoured sabatons; nothing but plate below the waist
classes.dragon_knight: A knight with a wyrm's blood, a fierce woman; crimson scale armor with black lacquer and tarnished gold trim, an open horned helm, scaled gauntlets ending in claws, a cloak lined in ember orange cut like a pair of folded wings, a single dragon-jaw pauldron, armored tassets of overlapping scales, a tail-like trailing sash
classes.gunner: A powder-stained master engineer, a weathered man; a long oilskin greatcoat with brass buttons and a high collar over a tooled leather cuirass, ornate brass goggles on a tall leather cap, bandoliers of engraved brass charges crossed on the chest, a heavy tool belt, one mechanical brass gauntlet of gears and pistons, scorched gloves, tall buckled boots
classes.ninja: A quiet killer from the far roads, a lean wiry man; a charcoal wrapped jacket of layered dark cloth bound at the waist with a long wine-red sash, a deep hood and a cloth mask over the lower face, lacquered black leather plates strapped on the forearms and shins, a coil of cord, a closed leather pouch of throwing irons and a row of small vials at the belt, soft split-toed boots wrapped to the knee, two short hooked knives sheathed at the small of the back

zombies.zombie_shambler: A risen villager buried in his best, grey-green rotting skin, a mouldering embroidered burial coat and winding sheet, one shoe, slack jaw, a funeral wreath still round the neck, arms hanging
zombies.zombie_gnawer: A thin fast dead thing, a starved grey-green corpse, stooped and long-limbed, long arms with hooked black nails, a stretched jaw full of teeth, sparse lank hair, a torn lace nightshirt hanging in strips, split grave-ribbons trailing from the wrists, bare feet
zombies.zombie_lurker: A dead woodsman half-grown into the forest floor, pine needles, moss and shelf fungus over a rotted hunting coat with tarnished buttons, clawed hands, antlers of root growing from one shoulder, a hood of moss
zombies.zombie_bonesack: A bloated corpse in a burst velvet waistcoat, belly swollen and split with yellow sacs, stubby legs, head tipped back, burial coins sunk in the eyes
zombies.zombie_brute: A huge corpse too big for one grave, broken chains at wrists and neck, an iron collar, stitched shoulders, the rags of an executioner's hood and apron
zombies.zombie_rimewalker: A soldier frozen dead on the march and still walking, blue-white frostbitten skin, a rimed greatcoat and cracked border-guard cuirass sheathed in ice, icicles hanging from the jaw and elbows, one arm locked stiff, snow packed in the eye sockets
zombies.zombie_driftling: A gaunt pale ghoul built to lie flat under snow, bone-white skin, long clawed arms, a tattered white fur mantle and frozen rags that make it a snowdrift from above, black frostbitten fingers and nose, jaw hung open
zombies.zombie_husk: A sun-dried mummified corpse, thin as rope, leather-brown skin tight on the bones, wind-shredded desert wrappings and the faded silk of a caravan robe trailing behind, hunched forward to sprint, sand pouring from the mouth
zombies.zombie_slinger: A sun-bleached skeleton in the rags of a caravan guard, half its ribs missing and the rest sharpened, a quiver made of its own ribcage, cracked leather harness, faded red headcloth, one long arm cocked back
zombies.zombie_drowner: A drowned corpse risen from a bog, swollen grey-green waterlogged skin, a rotted fisherman's oilskin, pond weed and reeds trailing from the shoulders, long dripping arms with webbed black hands, mouth full of mud
zombies.zombie_leechmother: A bloated drowned corpse in a burst mourning gown, its body a mass of fat black leeches clinging and hanging in ropes, pale belly split open, stubby legs, head tipped back, veil of pond weed
zombies.zombie_cinder: A charred corpse still smouldering, blackened cracked skin with dull ember-orange in the cracks, the burnt rags of a railway porter's uniform, brass buttons fused to the chest, smoke-stained jaw, clawed hands of coal
zombies.zombie_slagback: A huge corpse with a hump of cooled furnace slag and iron plate fused across its back and shoulders, a foundryman's leather apron, rivets through the skin, one arm cased in black iron, bent double under the weight
zombies.zombie_warden: A towering dead fortress captain frozen at his post, an ornate border-guard plate harness cased in ice, a great fur-collared cloak stiff with rime, a crown of icicles grown through the open helm, frost-white beard, gauntlets fused shut
zombies.zombie_dryking: A tall mummified desert king, sun-black skin on long bones, a tarnished gold collar and the bleached shreds of royal silk, a tall cracked crown of bone and gilt, jeweled finger-claws, robes of wind-torn linen trailing sand
zombies.zombie_abbess: A tall drowned abbess, grey waterlogged face under a rotted wimple and long veil, a black brocade habit heavy with water and silt, a long string of plain river-stone beads with no pendant, reeds and pond weed hanging from the sleeves, hands folded and clawed; no cross or holy symbol anywhere
zombies.zombie_stoker: A giant dead locomotive fireman, soot-black skin cracked with furnace glow, a scorched leather apron and iron-shod boots, a boiler plate riveted across the chest, a soot-caked cap fused to the skull, forearms like burnt timbers

summons.skeleton: A risen skeleton of an old cathedral guard, yellowed bone bound with grave dirt and dried sinew, in the corroded remains of ornate ceremonial armour: a rusted crested cap of engraved bronze, one tarnished gold-edged pauldron, a fluted breastplate fragment hung on the ribs by rotten straps, the tatters of a wine-red tabard and a sash of mouldering brocade, empty dark eye sockets
summons.ghoul: A violet-grey ghoul standing hunched forward, gaunt, long arms and long black nails, a stretched hungry jaw, lank thin hair, wrapped in the rags of a fine burial shroud of grey linen and black lace, a tarnished funeral collar of silver leaves still round the neck, grave-ribbons trailing from the wrists, bare clawed feet
summons.squire: A young knight-squire, a slight earnest young man; plain polished steel half-plate with fluted edges and a little tarnished gold trim, an open sallet helm, padded indigo gambeson sleeves, a short white and grey tabard cut like the lancers', a small pennant banner of plain white and grey stripes on a short pole strapped upright to the back, a sword belt with an empty scabbard, scuffed riding boots
summons.wolf: A lean grey hunting wolf of the drowned grove, long-legged and rangy, shaggy charcoal fur paling to ash at the belly, a scarred muzzle and one torn ear, amber eyes, a heavy collar of braided leather strung with carved bone beads and a tarnished brass ring, a few moss-green ribbons and pheasant feathers knotted into the ruff, a plain wolf, standing four-square with the head level and the tail hanging
summons.slime: A knee-high slime of glossy cobalt ooze shaped like a fat rounded droplet with a broad base, two small dark eyes and a sulky pout, a tiny tarnished gold coronet sunk into the top of it, a few jeweled rings and old coins suspended inside the jelly, a darker blue core
summons.whelp: A cat-sized young dragon, a crimson whelp with black lacquer-dark scales along the back and a pale ember-orange belly, a short snout with small teeth, two swept-back horns with a tarnished gold ring on one, leathery dragon wings held open and out to the sides with ember-orange membranes, four short clawed legs, a long tail ending in a spade
summons.turret: An ornate clockwork gun turret about waist-high: a short heavy cannon barrel of blackened iron with a flared brass muzzle pointing straight ahead, on a swivelling brass drum housing with exposed gears, pistons and a little copper boiler, a curved shield plate engraved with plain scrollwork, mounted on a squat three-legged tripod of riveted iron with clawed feet; powder-stained and worn
summons.totem: A carved spirit pole as tall as a man, three stacked carved faces, a bear at the bottom, an owl in the middle and a serpent on top, painted in faded teal and ochre over dark weathered wood, a pair of carved wing-boards spread at the top, hung with feathers, knotted cords, teeth and small copper discs, its foot wrapped in rope and planted in a small cairn of stones

scenery.pine: tall dark pine tree of a cold northern forest: a straight trunk of rough grey-brown bark, layered drooping tiers of dark blue-green needles to a narrow point, a few dead lower branches, a little moss at the foot; the whole tree, about three times as tall as it is wide, the trunk ending in a few short roots
scenery.oak: old gnarled oak tree: a thick twisted trunk of furrowed dark bark with ivy climbing it, a broad spreading crown of dense dark green leaves in heavy rounded clumps, a few bare crooked branches; the whole tree, a little taller than it is wide, the trunk ending in a few spreading roots
scenery.well: village well: a round knee-high wall of grey fieldstone, two carved oak posts holding a small steep slate roof with scrollwork eaves, a wrought-iron crank and winch with a rope and an iron-banded wooden bucket, moss between the stones; about as wide as a man is tall
scenery.bounty_board: village notice board: a broad board of dark weathered oak planks on two thick posts under a small pitched shingle roof with carved scrollwork eaves and iron brackets, five sheets of plain cream parchment nailed to it at angles, every sheet completely blank with nothing written, drawn or printed on it; as tall as a man and a little wider
scenery.signpost: crossroads signpost: a tall weathered oak post with three arrow-shaped boards pointing different ways, the boards plain bare wood with nothing carved, painted or written on them, an iron lantern hanging from a scrolled bracket, a small cairn of stones at its foot
scenery.market_stall: village market stall: a timber frame with a striped canvas awning of faded wine-red and bone-white, a plank counter laden with baskets of apples and turnips, sacks of grain, clay jugs and a hanging string of onions, crates stacked at one end, no signs and no writing anywhere; about two strides wide
scenery.fence: straight section of an old split-rail fence: three posts of weathered dark wood with carved caps and two rough rails between them, a little lichen; about four times as long as it is tall, seen from the front at a slight angle
scenery.stone_wall: straight section of a low dry-stone wall: knee-high rough stacked grey fieldstone with a capping row of upright stones, moss and a trail of ivy; about four times as long as it is tall, seen from the front at a slight angle
scenery.cottage: small one-storey village cottage, square in plan: whitewashed wattle walls in dark oak half-timbering on a fieldstone footing, a steep heavy thatched roof with gable ends left and right and a squat stone chimney, a heavy plank door with iron hinges in the middle of the front wall, two small leaded windows with shutters, a hanging lantern by the door, barrels and firewood at one corner; sooty and sagging, a dark fairy-tale village
scenery.townhouse: narrow two-storey village townhouse, square in plan: a ground floor of grey fieldstone with a heavy arched plank door in the middle of the front wall, a jettied upper storey of dark oak half-timbering and grey plaster, small leaded windows with carved shutters, a steep slate roof with gable ends left and right and a tall stone chimney, an empty wrought-iron bracket over the door with no sign hanging from it; sooty and leaning a little
scenery.snowpine: tall pine tree of a frozen northern waste: a straight trunk of grey bark split by frost, layered drooping tiers of dark blue-green needles weighed down with heavy snow, snow lying thick on every tier and small icicles hanging from the tips, a narrow point; the whole tree, about three times as tall as it is wide, the trunk ending in a few short roots; nothing but the tree itself: no stonework, no wall, no base or planter, no roof, no metal bands or brackets
scenery.dead_tree: dead tree of a blasted land: a crooked bare trunk of grey weather-bleached wood split down one side, peeling bark, a knot hole, a few twisted leafless branches reaching up and out like claws, not a single leaf; the whole tree, a little taller than it is wide, the trunk ending in a few gnarled roots; nothing but the tree itself: no stonework, no wall, no base or planter, no roof, no metal bands or brackets
scenery.char_tree: burnt tree of a land of ash and slag: a crooked trunk charred black and cracked into scales of charcoal, a dull rust-red in the deepest cracks, a few stumps of burnt branches, no leaves, grey ash lying on the top of every bough; the whole tree, about twice as tall as it is wide, the trunk ending in a few blackened roots; nothing but the tree itself: no stonework, no wall, no base or planter, no roof, no metal bands or brackets
scenery.palm: date palm of a desert oasis: a tall slender trunk of ringed grey-brown fibre with a gentle lean, a crown of long arching green fronds with a skirt of dry brown fronds hanging beneath it, a heavy cluster of amber dates under the crown; the whole tree, about three times as tall as it is wide, the trunk ending in a few short roots
scenery.inn: long two-storey village coaching inn, more than twice as wide as it is deep: a ground floor of grey fieldstone with one heavy arched double door in the middle of the front wall, a wrought-iron lantern on either side of the door, a jettied upper storey of dark oak half-timbering and grey plaster with a long row of small leaded windows, a long steep slate roof with gable ends left and right, two tall stone chimneys and a small dormer, an empty wrought-iron bracket over the door with no sign hanging from it, a bench and barrels by the wall; sooty and leaning a little
scenery.forge: village blacksmith's forge, square in plan: a heavy fieldstone smithy whose front wall is a wide open arch under a timber lintel, showing a stone hearth with a great hooded chimney, an anvil on a stump, a quench tub and racks of tongs and hammers inside, a steep slate roof with gable ends left and right, a tall soot-blackened stone chimney, a heap of coal and stacked firewood at one corner; sooty and worn, the hearth cold
scenery.shophouse: narrow two-storey village shop house, square in plan: a ground floor of dark oak framing with a heavy plank door in the middle of the front wall between two wide shop windows whose lower shutters are let down as counters, an upper storey of grey plaster and dark oak half-timbering jettied out over the shopfront on carved brackets, small leaded windows, a steep slate roof with gable ends left and right and a stone chimney at one end, an empty wrought-iron bracket over the door with no sign hanging from it, crates under the counters; sooty and leaning a little
scenery.cottage_2: small one-storey village cottage, square in plan: thick walls of rough grey fieldstone, a steep roof of heavy stone slates with gable ends left and right and a squat round stone chimney, a low arched plank door with iron hinges in the middle of the front wall, two small deep-set windows with shutters, a timber lean-to with a log pile along one side wall, moss on the roof; sooty and squat, a dark fairy-tale village
scenery.ruin_waste: broken block of a ruined border-fort wall: one square block of dressed grey ashlar stone as deep as it is wide and about twice as tall, plain flat faces with mortar joints, the top broken away in a jagged edge, sheathed in clear rime with short icicles along the break and snow lying on top
scenery.ruin_badlands: broken block of a ruined desert court wall: one square block of sun-baked red mudbrick as deep as it is wide and about twice as tall, plain faces with the plaster flaking off in patches, the top crumbled into a rounded broken edge, sand drifted into the cracks
scenery.ruin_fen: broken block of a ruined swamp abbey wall: one square block of plain coursed grey stone as deep as it is wide and about twice as tall, plain flat faces with no carving, the top broken away in a jagged edge, a dark waterline stain across the lower half, hanging moss and pond weed
scenery.ruin_ash: broken block of a ruined railway halt wall: one square block of heavy soot-black engineering brick on a course of cut basalt, as deep as it is wide and about twice as tall, plain faces, the top broken away in a jagged edge, scorched and dusted with ash
scenery.spire_ice: tall slender spire of blue-white glacier ice rising to a sharp point from a broad base, cracked and layered, frozen grey stone showing through near the foot and snow lodged on the ledges, about four times as tall as it is wide
scenery.spire_hoodoo: tall red sandstone hoodoo: an eroded pillar of banded rust-red and ochre rock, narrower in the middle, with a flat cap stone balanced on top, about four times as tall as it is wide
scenery.spire_basalt: cluster of tall black basalt columns: tight six-sided columns of dark volcanic rock of uneven heights rising from one shared base to a broken stepped top, grey ash in the joints, about four times as tall as it is wide
scenery.sarcophagus: plain stone sarcophagus: a long rectangular chest of grey stone on a low stepped plinth, about two and a half times as long as it is wide and knee high, closed by a heavy plain slab lid with a chamfered edge, chipped corners, old candle wax and dust on the lid, plain faces with no carving at all
scenery.chest: iron-bound treasure chest: a chest of dark oak planks about one and a half times as wide as it is deep and about as tall as it is deep, a rounded domed lid on two heavy iron hinges at the back, tarnished brass corner plates, broad iron bands over the lid and down the sides, a heavy plain iron hasp and lock plate at the front, an iron carrying handle at each end, worn and scuffed, closed
scenery.crypt_gate: tall square gatepost of an old crypt: a pier of dark weathered catacomb stone blocks about three times as tall as it is wide, on a plain stepped base, topped by a heavy flat overhanging cap stone with old candle wax pooled and dripping over its edge, rusted iron hinge pins on one side where a gate once hung, a small dark niche near the top holding two old skulls, cracks and moss in the joints, plain faces otherwise

weapons.w_sword: arming sword with a wide fullered blade and a crossguard of swept wings
weapons.w_axe: bearded war axe with a crescent blade pierced with scrollwork, on a notched haft bound in chain
weapons.w_mace: flanged processional mace shaped like a small cathedral bell
weapons.w_spear: long wyrm-lance with a leaf blade, a winged socket and a trailing silk pennon
weapons.w_bow: great recurved bow carved like a pair of antlers, leather-wrapped grip
weapons.w_pistol: heavy brass-fitted flintlock pistol with a flared muzzle and engraved lockplate
weapons.w_boomerang: hooked crescent throwing blade of blued steel with a pierced centre
weapons.w_staff: gnarled grave-iron staff shod with bone, an iron cage holding an ember at the head
weapons.w_wand: bone wand bound in silver wire with a candle-stub tip
weapons.w_lute: battered ornate lute inlaid with mother-of-pearl, a mourning ribbon tied at the neck
weapons.w_shield_kite: kite shield with an engraved border of scrollwork, plain painted field, no device
weapons.w_shield_tower: tall tower shield of fluted steel edged in tarnished gold, curved like a half-cylinder, as tall as a man's chest to his ankle, plain unmarked field, no device
weapons.w_lance: three-metre jousting lance: a long fluted shaft tapering to a leaf-shaped steel point, painted in spiral bands of black and tarnished gold, a great bell-shaped steel vamplate guarding the grip, a short leather grip and a steel butt below it

armour._about: Append one of these to a class subject line. Meshy makes one fused mesh, so each armour look is the whole character generated again and rigged the same way. Start with tiers 1 and 3.
cloth: a plainer travelling version of the costume in worn wool, still trimmed
shroud-silk robes with a simple embroidered hem
layered scholar's brocade with embroidered cuffs
vigil robes with metal-thread trim and a heavy mantle
ancient vestments of heavy brocade, tarnished gold clasps and a jeweled collar
leather: a plainer travelling version of the costume in cracked hide, still trimmed
a hunter's long coat with engraved shoulder plates
dark wyrmhide with scaled pauldrons and gold edging
plate: a plainer field version of the armor in rust-spotted mail, still crested
an iron breastplate over mail with simple fluting
full steel plate with fluted borders
templar plate with engraved borders and a long tabard
